title: Quantizing Recurrent Language Models Is Easier Than You Think
abstract: arXiv:2611.01864v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Linear recurrences are becoming an increasingly common building block in large language models, replacing the growing KV cache of softmax attention with a fixed-size recurrent state that enables efficient decoding. However, the quantization stack has largely been developed around softmax Transformers, whose numerical properties and inference state differ from those of recurrent models. Our goal is to understand these differences and study the design space of quantization methods for recurrent models. In our analysis, we differentiate between two targets. First, extra-state quantization concerns weights and activations outside the recurrent state, whose distributions are shaped indirectly by the sequence mixer during training. In controlled 1.3B parameter models, we find that decayed recurrences develop weaker residual outlier channels than softmax attention and are therefore easier to quantize without incoherence processing. translated_title: 量化循环语言模型比你想象的更容易
translated_abstract: 线性递归正日益成为大语言模型中的常见构建模块，它用固定大小的循环状态取代了softmax注意力中不断增长的KV缓存，从而实现高效解码。然而，现有的量化技术栈主要围绕softmax Transformer构建，其数值特性和推理状态与循环模型存在差异。我们的目标是理解这些差异，并研究循环模型量化方法的设计空间。在分析中，我们区分了两个量化目标。首先，状态外量化涉及循环状态之外的权重和激活值，其分布由序列混合器在训练过程中间接塑造。在受控的1.3B参数模型实验中，我们发现衰减型循环比softmax注意力产生更弱的残差异常通道，因此无需进行不相干性处理就能更容易地量化。其次，在……
tldr: 该论文首次系统研究了循环语言模型的量化设计空间，发现衰减型线性递归相比softmax注意力产生的异常通道更弱，因此无需特殊处理就能更容易地被量化。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically explores the quantization design space for recurrent language models, showing that decayed recurrences develop weaker residual outlier channels than softmax attention and are therefore easier to quantize without incoherence processing.
